**Overview:**  
Gemilang Harmoni Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company operating in the retail sector, specifically selling textiles and baju kurung, based in Sarawak. Incorporated on 21 Oct 1997, it has a paid‑up share capital of RM 5,000,000 and three directors. The largest shareholder holds 45.57 % of the equity, with no corporate shareholders recorded. The firm’s current status is active and it was previously known as Unity Industries Sdn. Bhd. until a name change on 3 Sep 2025. Both total cases and defendant claims are recorded as zero.
